source_note: 仅选主尊与其画面右侧四尊相邻罗汉，图版共五身，明确不代表十八罗汉全龛，也不代表五代至元全部飞来峰造像。保留布袋、念珠、笑面、袒腹与随意坐姿，并按照片保留托塔、合掌、持钵、坐姿四种邻像。输入输出已目视核查。无题记龛年代有争议，传统/景区归南宋，近年有元初研究意见；时间轴只作约略定位。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: a CAREFULLY SELECTED DETAIL of the historic FEILAIFENG NICHE68, BUDAI MAITREYA AND EIGHTEEN ARHATS, beside Cold Spring Stream, Hangzhou 杭州飞来峰第68龛布袋弥勒与十八罗汉龛（局部）. Draw the large seated laughing BUDAI and only FOUR immediately neighboring arhats at the viewer's RIGHT as a coherent five-figure detail, not the entire eighteen-arhat group. Image2 is the main real photograph, image3 provides supplemental detail of the same figures. The four small figures selected are: the rear upper arhat raising a small pagoda in his RIGHT hand; the arhat just below/right of him holding both palms together in front of his chest; the lower arhat immediately beside Budai leaning forward holding a shallow bowl; and the smiling seated lower-front arhat at the right with hands resting on his lap. Preserve their actual positions, scale, individual head forms and varied gestures from the photo. EXCLUDE the other partly visible figures at both far ends and the bearded figure behind the selected four, instead let the surrounding stone contours fade into white. Absolutely no invented fifth small attendant. The composition contains ONE LARGE BUDAI plus FOUR SMALL ARHATS. Main Budai is not a formal Buddha with curly hair: preserve the BALD wide smiling head, long ears, the open tooth-showing grin, huge exposed belly, loose robe slipping off the chest, casual asymmetrical reclining seated pose; his RIGHT hand at image-left rests on the large CLOTH SACK, and his LEFT hand at image-right holds a dangling strand of round prayer beads along his knee. Keep the lower robe spilling onto the irregular natural rock seat and the actual asymmetrical knees, not a symmetric lotus pose. Don't borrow the style master's face or add its halo. The photographed rock niche forms a rough low irregular arched edge over the figures; outline just the portion enclosing this selected group with8to12broken rock contours, leaving all recessed rock PURE WHITE. Preserve any actual chips at robe edges without inventing new damage or repairing all irregularities. Remove plants, moss, surface grain, cave darkness, water stains and all surrounding background. Sculpture planes and background are all PURE WHITE outlined in very fine black ink; no grey shadows, no filled black mouth/cavities, no dense rocky scribbles or crosshatching. Sparse folds and expressive delicate facial contours matching image1. historical_sources.evidence: 龛沿冷泉溪南岸天然岩形开凿，主尊左手念珠、右手布袋，左右各九罗汉；龛中间高、两边低。

historical_sources.title: 陈越：飞来峰第68龛弥勒造像的年代问题再探
historical_sources.publisher: 《美育学刊》2021年第6期（参考网刊载）
historical_sources.evidence: 研究指出第68龛缺少残留题记，宋代说与元代说长期并存，966年说史料不足；故本条不填写确切开凿年，公开年代争议。

site_recommendation.name: 飞来峰造像
site_recommendation.era: 南宋 · 第68龛（传统断代）
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1200仅为南宋传统断代的时间轴约略位置，不是开凿年份。该龛无纪年题记，研究亦有元初说；不用966年附会纪年。
site_recommendation.latlon_note: 取第68龛现场照片公开拍摄位置，作为冷泉溪边该龛附近的地图定位，非精密造像测绘点。
site_recommendation.lede: 冷泉溪畔，布袋弥勒依着布袋开怀而笑，罗汉们在岩龛里各具神情。第68龛把佛教造像带入生动的人间情态，也是飞来峰最熟悉的一幅面孔。

facts.label: 一龛群像
facts.text: 完整第68龛以布袋弥勒为中心，左右各列九尊罗汉；本图仅取主尊与邻近四尊罗汉。

facts.label: 布袋与念珠
facts.text: 主尊袒胸露腹，右手按布袋、左手执念珠，以布袋和尚形象表现弥勒信仰。

facts.label: 年代有争议
facts.text: 通行介绍采用南宋断代，也有研究主张元初；该龛未留确切纪年，不能用单一年份概括全山造像。
